evals.name: three-angle-cold-prospecting-set
evals.prompt: Write Meta ads for our meal-prep subscription (€6.90 per meal, chef-cooked, delivered Sundays, cancel anytime) targeting busy parents in Germany, cold audience, objective sales. We have 1,200 reviews averaging 4.7 stars and a 'first box 30% off' offer. Landing page: /first-box.
evals.expected_output: Three variations with distinct angles (e.g. problem→solution, social proof, direct offer), each with primary text ≤125-char hook, two headline options ≤40 chars, optional description ≤30 chars, CTA matching sales, creative direction with ratios and safe zones, and a hypothesis per variation.
assertions: Three variations use genuinely different angles, not reworded copies
Each hook line is under 125 characters and front-loads the value
Headlines are ≤40 characters with the offer or outcome in the first ~27
Uses the real proof provided (1,200 reviews, 4.7 stars, 30% off) and nothing invented
Creative direction specifies 4:5 and 9:16 ratios or safe zones and a first-2-second action

evals.name: retargeting-video-script
evals.prompt: We need a 20–30 second Reels ad script for people who added our running shoes (the Stride 2) to cart but didn't buy. Price $149, free returns within 60 days, 10% off with code BACK10. Tone: confident, not salesy.
evals.expected_output: A timestamped 20–30s vertical video script (hook 0–2s, problem, solution, proof, CTA), retargeting-stage CTA such as Shop now/Get offer, copy addressing the objection (fit/returns), 9:16 with safe zones and captions, plus at least two alternative variations or hooks.
assertions: Script is timestamped and fits 20–30 seconds with the hook in the first 2 seconds
Addresses the abandoned-cart objection using the free 60-day returns and the BACK10 code
CTA is appropriate for retargeting (Shop now / Get offer) and captions/on-screen text are specified
Creative direction is 9:16 with safe-zone guidance

evals.name: policy-safe-health-angle
evals.prompt: Write Facebook ad copy for our sleep supplement (melatonin-free, €29). My boss wants the hook to be 'Still can't sleep? Are you anxious at night?' and to show before/after photos of tired vs rested faces. Make it convert.
evals.expected_output: Copy that avoids personal-attribute phrasing and before/after body imagery, explains the policy risk briefly, and offers compliant alternatives (e.g. third-person or general framing, product-in-context visuals) in three variations with placeholders for any unverified claims.
assertions: Explicitly flags that 'Are you anxious at night?' style personal-attribute phrasing and before/after face photos are policy risks on Meta
Provides compliant alternative hooks that still address sleep problems
Does not invent clinical claims or statistics; uses placeholders where proof is missing
Delivers three variations in the skill's output format
